name: Lullaby for Me
source:
Exactly 2 months have passed since the catastrophe. One day you noticed a girl walking along the railroad tracks. Do you want to pay attention to her? Should you ignore her? Is she a hallucination? Is there a paradise?
Can YOU change the world?

Completed in a month for submission in Povidlo jam.

[From [url=https://niceed.itch.io/lullaby-for-me]Itch.io[/url]]
